description: This file contains functions and logic for managing model registry, availability, and related operations in a TypeScript project, including loading models, error handling, and converting models to data rows.

methods.name: hasAuthForProvider
methods.description: Checks if there is authentication available for a given provider based on configuration and auth store.

methods.name: createAvailabilityUnavailableError
methods.description: Creates an Error object with a specific code indicating model availability is unavailable.

methods.name: normalizeAvailabilityError
methods.description: Converts an unknown error into a standardized Error indicating model availability issues.

methods.name: validateAvailableModels
methods.description: Validates that the available models are an array of properly structured Model objects.

methods.name: loadAvailableModels
methods.description: Loads and filters available models from a registry, handling errors and suppression rules.

methods.name: loadModelRegistry
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the model registry, available models, and related info, with fallback error handling.

methods.name: toModelRow
methods.description: Converts a Model object and related parameters into a ModelRow data structure for display or processing.
